paths.introTitle: Study Paths in the Egyptian Baccalaureate System
paths.intro: The Egyptian Baccalaureate system is based on four main paths. The student chooses the path he wishes to study starting from the second secondary grade. The chosen path continues through the second and third secondary grades, with common subjects shared by all paths, in addition to the specialized subjects of each path.
paths.readCarefully: Please read the information about each path carefully before making your decision, and learn about the subjects, colleges and specializations related to each path.

medicine.name: Medicine & Life Sciences Path
medicine.intro: This path focuses on medicine, science and health fields, and is suitable for students wishing to study medical and scientific specializations.
medicine.secondSubjectTitle: Specialized subject in second grade (the student chooses one that counts toward the total)
medicine.thirdSubjectsTitle: Specialized subjects in third grade (mandatory and count toward the total)

engineering.name: Engineering & Computer Science Path
engineering.intro: This path focuses on engineering, computer science, artificial intelligence and technology, and is suitable for students wishing to study engineering and technology specializations.
engineering.secondSubjectTitle: Specialized subject in second grade (the student chooses one that counts toward the total)
engineering.thirdSubjectsTitle: Specialized subjects in third grade (mandatory and count toward the total)

business.name: Business Path
business.intro: This path focuses on business, management, economics and financial & administrative sciences, and is suitable for students wishing to study management and business specializations.
business.secondSubjectTitle: Specialized subject in second grade (the student chooses one that counts toward the total)
business.thirdSubjectsTitle: Specialized subjects in third grade (mandatory and count toward the total)

arts.name: Arts & Humanities Path
arts.intro: This path focuses on arts, languages, humanities and fine arts, and is suitable for students wishing to study literary, humanities and artistic specializations.
arts.secondSubjectTitle: Specialized subject in second grade (the student chooses one that counts toward the total)
arts.thirdSubjectsTitle: Specialized subjects in third grade (mandatory and count toward the total)

common.title: Common Subjects Between All Paths
common.intro: In addition to the specialized subjects, all students study some common subjects.
common.secondTotalNote: These subjects count toward the total.
secondOther: Physical Education — activity and practical exam only
third: Religious Education — passing requires getting 70% of the total grade.

sharedColleges.title: Colleges Shared Between All Paths
sharedColleges.note: Regardless of the path chosen, there is a group of colleges that all students of the four paths can compete for, according to the applicable admission rules. These include:

beforeChoosing.title: Before Choosing a Path
beforeChoosing.text: Choosing a study path is an important decision. Be sure to read the information of all four paths completely, compare the subjects, colleges and specializations related to each path, and choose the path that suits your interests and your academic and future goals.

paths.confirm: I confirm that I have read the information of the four paths and understood it well, and I agree to proceed to choosing the study path.
paths.success: Your choice has been saved successfully
paths.alreadyChosenNote: You have already chosen your path. You cannot change it after confirmation.
paths.lockedWarning: Make sure of your choice before confirming. You won't be able to change your path after that
